remoteWorkspace.name: Remote Workspace
remoteWorkspace.description: Bind remote servers (SSH), running Docker containers, or local WSL distros as additional workspaces; standard file tools operate on them via the workspace parameter, plus a file transfer tool
remoteWorkspace.toolkitDescription: Remote servers (SSH), Docker containers, or WSL distros as additional workspaces: once bound, use read/glob/write/edit/grep/run_command with workspace="<connection name>" to operate on them; remote_transfer moves files between local and remote
